scope: RETRIEVAL-SCOPE-2026-11-23 Rev 5 — witness R5, with single carriage (INDEX 249)
method: Each rendered request is the real loop package of the scripted R5 run rendered through the adapter's prompt renderer and carried in the connectors' transport body form — the attempt-6 method (INDEX 247). Components are exact serialized spans of the final body: retrieved_content = the JSON literal of each tool result's content, counted once (single carriage); case_view_and_assignment = the case span; tool_catalogue = the tools-section dump; provenance_and_dispatch = the view, delta, tool_results, standing-dispatch, bounds and position spans minus the retrieved content literals; remaining_overhead = the remainder (contract, framing, system message, body skeleton). Components sum to the serialized size; residual is stated per request.
